purpose: Bounded persistent SCAN fixture COUNT fusion comparison; not the original formal window or an adoption decision
build: CMake Release, LLVM coverage OFF, SCAN and HYBRID experimental formats ON, streaming-count default OFF; test-only per-thread enable switch
generator: ScanReadProofTest offline SCAN image builder, deterministic owner ID as integer value, no random generator
selectivity: threshold 0, midpoint and one greater than maximum; independently computed under PropertyValue type-sensitive ordering
ordering: alternate arm order each sample; same query, reopened database, snapshot policy, resource bounds and output consumption
oracle: independently compute expected count from generated properties and check full query result on every invocation
work: separate observer-enabled untimed query reports streamed and materialized row counts; samples record query time with observer disabled
resource_scope: 7 MiB fixture conversion/work budget; 64 MiB default query materialization; capture process peak RSS when available; allocations unavailable unless separately instrumented
limits: single thread, warm reopened database, no I/O-cold, concurrent/write or Kuzu claims; preserve all samples and instability; abort rather than enlarge budgets
